Resolution: Size in pixels of the internal preview render shown in the node viewer. Does not affect the line output.
Preset: Loads a ready-made L-system into the Lsystem page: plant, tree, bush, koch, dragon. custom keeps your own Axiom and Rules.
Growth: Manual growth amount, 0 = nothing drawn, 1 = fully grown. Used when Animate Growth is off.
Animate: On: growth loops automatically (grows, holds, restarts) at Grow Speed. Off: Growth sets it by hand.
Growspeed: Speed of the animated growth loop in cycles per second. 0.15 is about 6.7 seconds per cycle.
Treesize: Overall scale of each tree in world units. Also scales the random size variation.
Maxtrees: Upper limit on trees planted. If in1 has more points, they are evenly thinned to this count.
Variation: Randomness per tree. 0 = identical trees, 1 = random spin about Y and up to about 35 percent size difference.
Align: On: tilt each tree to follow the N attribute of its planting point. Off: trees stay upright along Y.
Seed: Random seed for per-tree spin and size. Change it to get a different arrangement.
Linewidth: Maximum branch line width in pixels, used by the Line MAT. Branches thin out according to Branch Taper.
Taper: How much thinner branches get with each nesting level. 1 = constant width, lower values = thinner twigs.
Colora: Colour of the trunk at the root. Blends toward Tip Color along the path (ignored by the Mono look).
Colorb: Colour of the branch tips. Blends from Root Color along the path (ignored by the Mono look).
Axiom: Starting string of the L-system. Draw symbols: F G A B 0 1; f moves; + and - turn; | reverses; [ ] push and pop.
Rule1: Rewriting rule in the form X=F+[X]-X. Each iteration replaces every occurrence of the left symbol with the right side.
Rule2: Second rewriting rule in the form F=FF. Leave empty if not needed.
Rule3: Third rewriting rule in the form A=AB. Leave empty if not needed.
Iterations: How many times the rules are applied. Higher = more detail but many more segments (capped at 6000 per tree).
Angle: Turn angle in degrees for each + and - symbol.
Lengthscale: Length multiplier applied to branches at each nesting level. 1 = same length, lower = shorter sub-branches.
Heading: Initial direction in degrees in the XY plane. 90 is straight up, 0 points right.
Anchor: root: the tree starts at its planting point and grows away from it. center: the tree is centered on the planting point.
Regenerate: Pulse: re-expand the L-system string and rebuild the tree geometry.
Camdist: Distance of the preview camera from the tree in world units.
Camlift: Height in world units that the preview camera looks at and sits at. Raise it to see taller trees.
Fov: Field of view of the preview camera in degrees.
Bgcolor: Background colour of the preview render. Ignored in the Mono look, which uses black.
Look: original: root-to-tip colours with bright growing tips. mono: bone-white and grey lines on black.
Accent: Mono look only: amount of red applied to growing tips and branch ends. 0 = none, 1 = full red.
